summary: Accepted the AI-compute, networking and hyperscaler-monetization relationship to NVIDIA with high positive sensitivity and high confidence. NVIDIA's accelerator, networking, interconnect, system and software revenue directly transmits current infrastructure demand into margins and cash flow. Hyperscaler capex, export controls, custom silicon, supply commitments and valuation remain explicit security-level constraints; no strategy or follow-up operation was created.

The results release reports 85% year-over-year growth and USD 91 billion Q2 guidance while preserving the forward execution risk.
The maintained idea independently documents networking, foundry and hyperscaler capex demand and its utilization, depreciation, energy and custom-silicon risks.
